records.title: Vision Function Layer in Multimodal LLMs
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.24791. Primary abstract analyzes visual-function layers in multimodal LLMs and uses selective data for training; its efficiency claim is data selection/training, not inference.

records.title: FPSAttention: Training-Aware FP8 and Sparsity Co-Design for Fast Video Diffusion
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.04648. Primary abstract accelerates video diffusion generation with FP8/sparsity co-design; video diffusion is outside LLM inference scope.

records.title: LongReD: Mitigating Short-Text Degradation of Long-Context Large Language Models via Restoration Distillation
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.07365. Primary abstract proposes distillation/pretraining to preserve short-text quality in long-context LLMs; the work is training-focused.
